adjudicated.en: Taichi: "CoOoOovEeEr... diIiIsguiIiIse..."

adjudicated.assessment: The source contains only a sobbing exclamation. The English invents the words 'cover' and 'disguise' and a prolonged performance not present in the line.

adjudicated.jp: 嗚咽。
adjudicated.en: Odd sobbing moans.
adjudicated.assessment: 嗚咽 means sobbing. 'Odd' and the plural 'moans' add characterization and a vocal quality not specified.

adjudicated.en: I hang my head.
adjudicated.assessment: The English is supportable by the bound Japanese source in this unit.

comments: Wall of text justifying why references to Fate/Stay Night doujins are every bit as perfectly appropriate as ones to Kagetsu Tohya doujins. -GHS
adjudicated.assessment: The source uses a conventionally censored vulgar noun. The opaque alphanumeric invention neither supplies an English obscenity nor reproduces a recognizable English censorship convention.

adjudicated.assessment: ギンギン describes being fully erect. 'Twangy' is the wrong physical quality, while 'in ecstasy' adds an emotional state not stated.

adjudicated.jp: 身につける。
adjudicated.en: I wear them back.

adjudicated.assessment: The source uses a childish euphemistic distortion of the body-part term. The invented English syllables are opaque and do not signal either the referent or a recognizable euphemism.

adjudicated.jp: 少し救われた。

adjudicated.assessment: Taichi asks himself why he had been naked from the waist down. The English addresses a second person, treats the body as a detachable object, then appends 'me' without grammatical function.
